content:
On the eve of a major iPhone event, Apple has just rolled out the new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here's what this update includes.

iOS 26.6.2 fixes an issue where software could not be updated over a cellular network.

Apple is expected to release iOS 27 very soon, most likely as early as next week.

However, ahead of this major release, Apple today pushed out a smaller iOS 26.6.2 update.

You can install iOS 26.6.2 on your iPhone via Settings > Software Update.

Here are Apple's official release notes:

Given the security patch that iOS 26.6.2 delivers, it makes sense to release it on the eve of the expected iOS 27 launch.

If iOS 26.6.1 prevented users from installing iOS 27 over cellular, that could have spelled big trouble for both Apple and users next week.

By rolling this update out in advance, many iPhones will now have the necessary patch in place before installing the much-anticipated iOS 27.

So this isn't a particularly noteworthy release on its own, but it has arrived at just the right time, right before iOS 27 and a host of new features.

Alongside iOS 26.6.2, Apple has also released iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad with the same security fix.

Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Spotted any other changes? Drop them in the comments.
